hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=$input|Out-String|ConvertFrom-Json; if($p.tool_input.command -match 'secrets/[^.\n]*[\r\n]|\.env[^.]|git +push +.*--force'){Write-Error 'BLOCKED: touches secrets or force-push'; exit 2} else {exit 0}"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=$input|Out-String|ConvertFrom-Json; if($p.tool_input.command -match 'os\.(getenv|environ)\([\x27\x22](GEMINI|OPENAI|ANTHROPIC|GROQ|CEREBRAS|HUGGING|GITHUB_TOKEN)[_A-Z]*[\x27\x22]'){Write-Error 'BLOCKED: use read_secret() not os.getenv for API keys'; exit 2} else {exit 0}"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=$input|Out-String|ConvertFrom-Json; if($p.tool_input.command -match 'docker compose (up|down|restart)'){Write-Host '[Hook] Remember: docker compose up is the canonical way to run the stack' -ForegroundColor Yellow} exit 0"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=$input|Out-String|ConvertFrom-Json; $f=$p.tool_input.file_path; if($f -match 'secrets/' -and $f -notmatch '\.example$' -and $f -notmatch '\.gitkeep$'){Write-Error 'BLOCKED: writing to secrets/'; exit 2} else {exit 0}"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=$input|Out-String|ConvertFrom-Json; $f=$p.tool_input.file_path; if($f -match '\.py$'){Write-Host '[Hook] Python file modified — remember: all LLM calls go through normalize.py' -ForegroundColor Yellow} exit 0"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=$input|Out-String|ConvertFrom-Json; $f=$p.tool_input.file_path; if($f -match '(llm_core|resolver)\.py' -and $f -notmatch 'normalize\.py'){Write-Error 'BLOCKED: routes must not modify llm_core.py or resolver.py directly — use normalize.py'; exit 2} else {exit 0}"
